sanskrit: āśānām āśāpālebhyaś caturbhyo amṛtebhyaḥ | idaṃ bhūtasyādhyakṣebhyo vidhema haviṣā vayam ||
english: To the four immortal Guardians of the Quarters (āśāpāla), the overseers of all beings — we would do honour with oblation.

sanskrit: ya āśānām āśāpālāś catvāra sthana devāḥ | te no nirṛtyāḥ pāśebhyo muñcatāṃhasoaṃhasaḥ ||
english: Ye four divine Guardians of the Quarters who stand as sentinels — may they release us from the nooses of Nirṛti, from sin upon sin.

sanskrit: aśloṇas te haviṣā vidheyam asrāmas te ghṛtenā juhomi | ya āśānām āśāpālas turīyo devaḥ sa naḥ subhūtam eha vakṣat ||
english: Thee who art without blemish I would honour with oblation; thee who art without wound I offer ghee. May the fourth divine Guardian of the Quarters bring great prosperity hither to us.

sanskrit: svasti mātra uta pitre no astu svasti gobhya uta pūruṣebhyaḥ | viśvaṃ subhūtaṃ suvidatram astu no jyog eva dṛśema sūryam ||
english: May there be welfare for our mother and likewise for our father; welfare for the cattle and for men. May all be of good being and well disposed toward us; may we look upon the sun for a long time.

sanskrit: idaṃ janāso vidathaṃ mahad brahma vadiṣyati | na tat pṛthivyāṃ no divi yataḥ prāṇanti vīrudhaḥ ||
english: O people, at the assembly a great brahman shall be proclaimed — one that is neither upon the earth nor in heaven, from which the plants draw breath.

sanskrit: antarikṣe samahāsāṃ sthānaṃ śrāntasadām iva | āsthānam asya bhūtasya viduṣ ṭad vedhaso janāḥ ||
english: Its abode is in the atmosphere, like the resting place of those who have grown weary. Wise and creative men know that as the foundation of this being.

sanskrit: yad rodasī rejamāne bhūmiś ca niratakṣatām | ārdraṃ tad adya sarvadā bhidurasyeva vartasī ||
english: When the two quivering worlds and the earth were fashioned — that [cosmic principle] is moist even today and always, revolving like the rim of a wheel about to split.

sanskrit: viśvam anyābhi vavāra viśvam anyasyām adhi śritam | dive ca viśvavedase pṛthivyai cākaraṃ namaḥ ||
english: One [sphere] has enveloped the all; upon the other the all rests. To Heaven, omniscient, and to Earth I have made obeisance.

sanskrit: saṃ saṃ sravantu sindhavaḥ saṃ vātā divyā uta | tebhir me sarvaiḥ saṃsrāvair dhanaṃ saṃ srāvayāmasi ||
english: Let the rivers flow together; let the divine winds also flow together. With all those confluent streams I cause wealth to flow hither to me.

sanskrit: ye saṃsrāvāḥ saṃsravanti kṣīrasya codakasya ca | tebhir me sarvaiḥ saṃsrāvair dhanaṃ saṃ srāvayāmasi ||
english: The confluences that flow together — of milk and of water — with all those confluent streams I cause wealth to flow hither to me.

sanskrit: ye nadībhyaḥ saṃsravanty utsāsaḥ sadam akṣitāḥ | tebhir me sarvaiḥ saṃsrāvair dhanaṃ saṃ srāvayāmasi ||
english: The springs that flow together out of the rivers, ever perennial and unfailing — with all those confluent streams I cause wealth to flow hither to me.

sanskrit: idaṃ havyā upetana- -idaṃ saṃsrāvaṇā uta | ihaitu sarvo yaḥ paśur asya vardhayatā rayim ||
english: Come hither, ye bearers of oblation; come hither, ye confluent ones as well. May every head of cattle come here; increase the riches of this man.
